source_text: Ingens cura expositionis; quasi ad grande spectaculum aciem mentis intendite. Gloria Deo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Huge care of exposition; as to a great spectacle aim the mind’s edge. Glory to God. Amen.
pass_b_english: Lean in: the land’s judgment is a hard spectacle for the mind. Glory to God. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
